name: settings-yaml11-document
about: G8：手写的 pilotdeck.yaml 带 %YAML 1.1 指令、合并键、yaml-1.1 的布尔 / 八进制 / 时间戳 / !!set / !!pairs / !!binary 时，从界面 update_settings。基线 updateLocalSettings.ts:73-84 用 yaml@2.9.0 parseDocument + setIn + document.toString() 原样写回（保留 %YAML 行与 ---，时间戳按 toISOString 重写，二进制重新编码）；路径上缺的中间层由 collectionFromPath 建成 JS Map，在 1.1 schema 下成为带 !!omap 的有序映射，之后候选配置的校验与落盘照比。
config:
%YAML 1.1
---
# hand-written
limits: &limits
  maxContextTokens: 65536
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  <<: *limits
  model: bbx/deterministic
  maxOutputTokens: 8192
model:
  providers:
    bbx:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        deterministic:
          thinking:
            state: enabled
            efforts: [low, medium, high]
            format: openai
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
telemetry:
  enabled: false
legacyFlag: yes
legacyOct: 010
legacyWhen: 2001-12-14t21:59:43.10-05:00
legacySet: !!set
  ? a
  ? b
legacyPairs: !!pairs
  - a: 1
  - a: 2
legacyBin: !!binary aGVsbG8=
